versions.changelog:
okx-growth-competition 3.1.3

- Expanded and clarified competition rules and lifecycle documentation in SKILL.md.
- Added explicit, hardcoded guidance for all competitions running on both Solana and the backend-specified EVM chain.
- Strengthened output structure: all user-facing responses must strictly follow fixed templates for each competition step.
- Clearly separated internal IDs from all user-facing messages; activities must be referenced by name only.
- Updated intent-routing and output constraints to avoid error-prone freeform or ambiguous responses.
- Documented new and existing command behaviors, flag requirements, and backend limitations.
